history.summary: Radha Krishna Temple at New Reserve Colony, Phesama (Tekhuba, Phesama), on the Kohima-Dimapur highway about 3 km south of Kohima town. One directory listing says it was 'established in recent years' with no date given - founding history is unverified. It serves as a spiritual centre for the local Hindu community in the Kohima area, with bhajans and festivals like Janmashtami and Radha Ashtami. Coordinates corroborated by two directory listings (25.6429, 94.1110). Thin record - verify details on the ground.

name: Radha Krishna Temple
town_description: Kohima, Nagaland's hill capital at about 1,444 m, is known for the Second World War Kohima War Cemetery, the annual Hornbill Festival at Kisama, and Angami Naga culture. It is the state's main administrative centre and the gateway town for the surrounding hill districts.

travel.road: New Reserve Colony, Phesama, on the Kohima-Dimapur highway (NH-29), ~3 km south of Kohima town (verify).
